page.overview:
Who is Carlinya Sorevin?

Carlinya was 5'5" or 165 cm tall, pale, with cool, almost black eyes and a broad face. After most of her dark hair was fried off in a Tel'aran'rhiod nightmare, she wore it in a cap of dark curls. She was of moderate build, neither slender nor stout.

She was somewhat messy, her hair sometimes being unkempt and her dress edge muddy from forgetting to wear a cloak. She often dressed in white with white embroidery, including a white skirt embroidered with scrolls.

She had a cold manner, seldom showing any sign of emotion. Her rationality made few concessions for human foibles. Or for anyone disagreeing with her. Siuan Sanche thinks she is "A great deal of logic and not much common sense".

With a One Power strength level of , Carlinya was strong by Aes Sedai standards and among the top tier of channelers among the Rebel Aes Sedai. Among the Salidar Six, she is as strong as Anaiya Carel, Morvrin Thakanos and Myrelle Berengari, but not as strong as Sheriam Bayanar.
